policy: This file is an accounting ledger for accessibility violations that are knowingly unfixed.
It is NOT a mute switch: every entry names one exact target, one exact axe rule id and one exact node selector.
The runner fails the build in all three of these cases, so entries cannot rot silently:
1. a violation that no entry claims;
2. an entry that matched nothing in this run (stale — the violation is gone, delete the entry);
Wildcards, empty strings and multi-rule entries are rejected at load time.
`incomplete` results are never claimed here — axe could not decide, so a human must, via the manual matrix.
Fields (all required, all strings): target, rule, selector, reason, owner, expires (YYYY-MM-DD).
